_comment: W3C SPARQL 1.1 tests that do NOT pass on a qualified backend (CRA-024.7). Every entry is a failure, not a pass: the conformance test requires each one to still fail exactly as recorded AND to fail the same way when replayed straight against the engine (engine_direct), i.e. an engine deviation, not an EOIP defect. An entry that starts passing makes the test fail until it is removed. Decision: D-CRA-024-06.
